name: The Lord of the Rings: Return to Moria

config.title: MoriaServerConfig.ini
config.default:
[Main]
OptionalPassword=

[World]
Name="AMP Powered LOTR: Return to Moria Dedicated Server"
OptionalWorldFilename=

[World.Create]
Type=campaign
Seed=random

Difficulty.Preset=normal
Difficulty.Custom.CombatDifficulty=default
Difficulty.Custom.EnemyAggression=high
Difficulty.Custom.SurvivalDifficulty=default
Difficulty.Custom.MiningDrops=default
Difficulty.Custom.WorldDrops=default
Difficulty.Custom.HordeFrequency=default
Difficulty.Custom.SiegeFrequency=default
Difficulty.Custom.PatrolFrequency=default

OptionalDLC.Array="DurinsFolk"
UpgradeOptionalDLC.Array=""

[Host]
ListenAddress=
ListenPort=7777
AdvertiseAddress=auto
AdvertisePort=-1
InitialConnectionRetryTime=60
AfterDisconnectionRetryTime=600

[Console]
Enabled=false

[Performance]
ServerFPS=60
LoadedAreaLimit=12

notes: Aus den AMP-Vorlagen von CubeCoders erzeugt (MIT), noch nicht im Selbsttest geprüft. Läuft über Wine. Einige Ports stehen nur in der Spielkonfiguration: Standard-Ports, nur ein Server pro Rechner.
